_about: Twin Dial round 1, package VD: the two dials in dial units. Lengths are fractions of R = the centre line of the thin outer white bezel ring; angles are degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (0 = top, -125 = lower left); x right, y down from the dial centre. 'refs' = the dials that agree (02L/02R = reference 02 left/right, etc.; measured on package VR's homography-rectified frames). status: verified = measured; hypothesis = read by eye, from one blurred reference, or inferred. Variant A = references 02 and 05 (ticks inside the band); variant B = reference 04 (white rule, ticks outside the band, thick rim, the solid red wedge). The spec value follows 02 (sharpest, homography rms 0.35 px) unless noted.

radius.note: definition of R; right dial / left dial = 0.9986 (02), 0.9983 (04), 1.0016 (05): the two dials are the same size

width.method: VR line FWHM, blur 10-90 < 1.6 src px so FWHM ~ width

profile.value: flat white line, sharp edges, no gradient
profile.note: 02 white clipped 26 %, 05 56 %: the profile cannot be read; VC

ends_deg.note: open at the bottom, symmetric about 180; 02L is hidden by the hybrid arc

outer_edge.method: half-level crossing of the median radial luma profile, windows 240-300 and 60-120 deg

tick_strip.note: a lighter grey annulus at the band's outer edge carrying the ticks (variant A); 04 has a white rule at 0.905 (width 0.020) instead and the ticks outside it at 0.925-0.939

shading_srgb_over_white.status: verified (sRGB code/255, not linear; VC owns the colour)
shading_srgb_over_white.note: brightens outward roughly linearly; luma relative to the clipped bezel white

texture.note: 02 and 05: smooth gradient, no repeatable FFT peak at the references' resolution (0.5 % R per source px). 04 alone: a regular grid, pitch about 0.044 R, diagonal, contrast a few % — may be screen moire. Spec: subtle noise/grid <= 3 % luma, pitch 0.03-0.045 R, to be chosen by eye on the bench

feet.value: the band continues past the scale ends to the bezel ends (+-144 deg) and ends there in a radial cut; nothing below it
feet.status: verified on rectified 02 and 04 (2026-11-17); the round-1 grey trapezoids below the ends are WITHDRAWN, they are not in any reference

radius.note: references disagree by 0.014 R (4 dials say 0.531): different software variants; spec takes 02 with the 02 band

inner_disc.shading: none in 02; 05 (render) ~0.05 flat; no vignette measured

law.value: piecewise linear: 0 km/h at -125, 100 at 0, 300 at +125; 24.93 deg per major; 20 km/h per major below 100, 40 km/h per major above 100

alt.05: 0 at -130.1, 100 at ~0, 300 at +128.0 (25.9 deg/major below, 25.5 above)
alt.04 mph: linear, 20 mph per 25.0 deg major, 100 at 0, 200 at +124.8

law.method: dark major lines in the band at 260.2, 285.1, 310.0, 335.0, 25.2, 50.1, 75.0, 99.9, 124.9 deg; minor ticks lattice pitch 6.233 deg, rms < 0.2

law.value: linear 0..8 x1000 rpm; 0 at -120, 8 at +120, 30.0 deg per 1000
law.note: 02's left dial is a power meter. Choose 04 (the only facelift tacho with the solid wedge) or 05; the speedometer's +-125 sits between

numerals.note: upright, centred on the value angle; 0 has no numeral (OFF / READY sits there); 7 and 8 red

major.note: same length, wider. 04: round dots 0.039 wide at 0.925-0.939

major_band_line.colour: near black (85-98 % darker than the band)

wedge.note: covers band and tick strip from the rim's outer edge to 0.94; ticks/dots and numerals on it are bright red; start = redline value (variable), end = scale end

alt_05.value: no wedge: a red arc replaces the bezel from 66.6 to 144.9 deg at rho 0.97-1.025, numerals 7 and 8 red

needle.axis: straight radial line through the centre

tip.note: crosses the tick strip and the dark gap, stops at the bezel's inner edge

width.note: widest just outside the rim, tapering outward; a tapered stub inside the rim; no hub cap

OFF.note: in the left foot, below scale 0

bar.status: verified (red bar in 04L); hypothesis for 04R (same layout by eye)
bar.note: left = fuel (0 .. 1/1), right = coolant (C .. H); segmented, count not resolved (4-5)

unit_label.where: curved along the outside, theta 149-164, rho 0.93
